primaryDecision: Reconstruct Participant, Spectator, Audience, Human/Agent/controller and Rule/Standard vocabulary as derived scope-qualified views and display labels over existing role, causal-access, control, authority, GameForm, provenance and norm sources. Do not create a Participant entity kind, participation scalar, collective Audience Subject, universal controller substrate enum or Rule-vs-Standard ontology. FinalityStatusView is already owned by GPR2 and is not reconstructed again.

existingSources: GPR1 RoleCausalAccessProfile, AuthorityProfile and control/access sources
current GameForm/product profile for Player count/form labels
GPR3 NormApplicationView, InterpretiveCommitment, ConventionStatusView and currentness/version sources
sourceDerivedBoundary.reason: All target concepts are high-value query/UI/authoring vocabulary whose semantics can be derived from already-separated sources. Persisting them as new truth would recreate categories previously falsified by GDF3/GDF0.

ParticipantView.purpose: Answer in what explicitly queried sense an entity/role/holder participates in a GameInstance, Gameplay enactment, event, PlayPractice, tournament or other named scope without creating an unqualified participant boolean.
ParticipantView.channelPolicy: Channel/relation families remain open and owner-local. GDF3's Observe/Advise/Propose/Execute/Evaluate/Adjudicate/Verify/Enforce/Modify/Adapt list is probe vocabulary, not a frozen universal vector.
laws: participation descriptor does not imply GameAction control
participation descriptor does not imply binding authority
same entity may participate in one scope and not another
no universal participation scalar or threshold is required

SpectatorView.purpose: Provide a familiar spectator/viewer presentation over an entity's observation relation while explicitly exposing any additional expression, report, advice, vote, aggregate contribution, control or authority channels.
laws: spectator and Player roles may coexist or remain distinct
presentation labels are lossy and require drill-down when correctness matters

AudienceView.purpose: Represent a live/event/practice audience as a collection or cohort plus any observation, expression and aggregation mechanisms without treating the audience as one Subject, one Player or one authority holder.
outOfScopePolysemy: product_target_audience belongs to Product/Market/user-research context rather than this live Game audience view
document frontmatter audience is readership metadata, not Game audience
laws: audience heterogeneity must not be silently collapsed into one belief/preference/motive state
aggregation rule is semantically material when aggregate input affects control or Game parameters

ControlRealizationView.purpose: Give Human/Agent/UI tooling a compact answer to who holds the control role/principal and how that control is realized, while separating Player/role identity, controller locus, cognition/realization substrate, provider identity, delegation and authority.
laws: single-player product label can coexist with many Agent/policy-controlled World actors
production Agent != runtime Game participant by identity
runtime system intelligence != World Subject by identity

NormVocabularyView.purpose: Expose familiar local labels such as rule, standard, guideline, policy, criterion, convention or procedure over current norm/application sources while preserving the richer underlying properties and refusing a universal Rule-vs-Standard schema binary.
NormVocabularyView.labelPolicy: Labels are descriptive/authoring vocabulary unless a particular GameForm explicitly defines a local schema meaning. Generic tooling must inspect underlying norm properties and current authority rather than infer semantics from the label.
laws: local enum rule|standard is allowed when its owner explicitly defines the local distinction

VocabularyCompatibilityDiagnostic.purpose: Detect when Human/Agent-facing vocabulary has silently collapsed distinct Game semantics or crossed ownership boundaries.
laws: diagnostic does not create participation/control/authority/norm truth
lossy vocabulary is permitted when source drill-down survives
local product terminology may remain intentionally simpler than generic semantics
fail visible when a label would cause a correctness-critical hidden implication

StationZeroControllerKind.finding: player|agent|policy|none works locally but mixes a Player/control-locus category with Agent/policy realization categories. Keep local; do not promote to generic ControllerKind ontology.

StationZeroSinglePlayerProduct.finding: The product is single-player even though pirate/swarm and multiple actors are Agent/policy controlled. This proves Agent/controller count is not Player count.

StationZeroAgentPolicyDecisions.finding: AgentDecision vs PolicyDecision identifies how actor decisions are produced. It does not by itself determine Player, Participant or authority status.

RequireHumanAuthorityLabel.finding: require-human is an owner-local Team policy outcome. It must not generalize into Human substrate as universal superior authority.

CommittedByNamespaces.finding: player:... and agent:... provenance namespaces are useful audit labels but do not define universal Player/Agent authority semantics.

PreG0AgentRoleAtlas.finding: Production Agents, runtime Game-system intelligence and World/Subject Agents are distinct loci. Agent alone is too broad to infer runtime participation or World subjecthood.

DocumentationAudienceFrontmatter.finding: Many docs list audience: player/agent/developer. This is document readership metadata and must not feed Game AudienceView.

ProductTargetAudienceUsage.finding: Target audience in product validation concerns intended users/market cohort, not a session/broadcast audience relation.

RulesetIdVersion.finding: station-zero-core version refs are strong RuleRepresentation/currentness inputs but are not complete EffectiveRuleTopology by identity.

TeamPolicies.finding: authority, observation, coordination, risk/loot/retreat policies serve different functions; the word policy does not determine constitutive Game-rule status.

PlayerVisibleReplayFlag.finding: player-visible replay evidence describes projection visibility, not whether an entity/event is a Player/Participant.

implementationDecision.reason: Current Station Zero already benefits from player/agent/policy and player-facing labels, but has no live spectator/audience participation feature. Generic Participant/Spectator/Audience persistence would be speculative. The immediate value is conceptual/API/UI discipline and possible pure derived/debug views, not new tables or a generic social-participation subsystem.
safeImmediateCandidates: terminology/audit guard that StationZeroControllerKind is local shorthand and not a generic ontology
pure ControlRealizationView for debug/Agent context if current controller semantics become confusing
keep single-player/product Player labels independent from Agent/policy actor count
reuse exact ruleset/policy/currentness refs when generating Human/Agent norm labels
avoid exposing raw rule|standard schema categories unless one local GameForm defines them
